description:
[Trading Data API] ERC-20 token balance for an address or ENS name, with token symbol and decimals read from the contract — ERC-20 token balance for an address or ENS name, with token symbol and decimals read from the contract. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-token-balance?address=0xB71C06dAC44c91bc997FB84C247DeEF676F4A9f6&token=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913&chain=base`

address.description: Required. Holder: a 0x address or an ENS name.

chain.description: Optional. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default base).

name: chain_token_balance
